diagnosis_limitations: Model input retained only three signals and one numeric row, omitting 25 numeric rows.
Pool capacity was collected but omitted from model context, limiting any exhaustion/capacity assertion.
Database threads-connected observations are counterevidence, not proof of general database health.
Reduced rows per execution includes keepalive/query-mix effects and does not establish SQL plan regression.
The report calls omitted middle projection points an eight-minute upstream sampling gap; retained projection omission is not proof of missing source samples.
Threads-connected summary sample_count was 138 with 149 original points; the report incorrectly treated max=11 as only 11 samples.

The model did not receive max_connections, so it cannot establish nonsaturation solely from a connected-count range. Separate direct observations of 9/40 are not retrospectively part of the model input.

presentation.business_symptom: 应用池6个连接全部占用，获取等待升至600ms、队列24、错误比例1，请求p95最高约7.79秒；数据库全局连接仍保持9/40。关闭后负载释放、等待与错误回落。
presentation.zabbix_comparison: 本次ON至恢复窗口没有新增Zabbix触发器事件。MySQL官方拒绝连接规则检查数据库达到连接上限后的拒绝，而本次阻塞发生在应用池，数据库仍有余量；当前应用HTTP扩展未配置相应触发器，Zabbix本身可补充应用规则。
presentation.platform_clues: 平台自主发现8个新变化信号，约83.5秒看到关联本轮信号的新报告，提示应用连接获取瓶颈并保留根因未知。实际模型输入只保留3个信号和1个数值摘要，遗漏已采集的池容量与部分业务指标，不能把候选解释当根因确认。报告还误把投影省略当上游缺采、把连接数最大值11当样本数，分析质量待修正。
